ops.body:
- [loop] The JSON stores go into the zip uncompressed (`ZipPassThrough`, `backup/shell.ts`): only the media are compressed already, and the owner asked for "compressed"; deflate the JSON (`ZipDeflate`) and count the traces in the room's estimate (the diff review's auditor A4, low; test `back-up-everything audit` next: the JSON entries are deflated and read back).
- [loop] On the web each written chunk is kept as a `Uint8Array` on the heap until the download; wrap each in a `Blob` (or join into blobs of about 8 MB) so the browser may page them out (auditor A5, low).
- [loop] The page's failure or missing-files line comes back when the page is opened again later (the shell's store outlives the page); `load()` clears `after` and `failed` when no backup is being made (auditor A6, low).
- [loop] A backup outlives its page: Back, then Start, and the download or the share sheet comes over the walk screen; hold Back while one is being made, or hand the file over only while the page is up (auditor A7, low; an e2e step).
- [loop] A `backup_last` write that throws after the file was handed over reports "could not be made" for a file that was made (auditor A8, low).
- [loop] The reader (`readBackup`) reads a missing trace entry as an empty trace, throws on a moment with no pieces, and never checks the manifest's `stores` against the entries (a truncated file reads as whole); for the restore slice: refuse a file whose entries do not match its manifest, and treat every `file_path` as untrusted (`mediaEntry` passes a `\`) (auditor A10, low).
- [loop] The "Your data" row stands alone under a rule with no heading of its own (the ux-reviewer's U6, low, mostly opinion).
- [loop] `db.looseMoments()` has no caller since back-up-everything audit 16 reads every moment once (`momentsBetween(0, MAX)`, the one all-time read a backup makes, once per tap, beside the callers the storage rule lists); keep it for the restore slice or remove it with its contract case (low).

argv: Map, walk screen and motion polish
ops.body: - [loop] The raised drawer's grabber is drawn over the text scrolled under it (Walk settings at 390 and 320 px, seen in the back-up-everything pictures; the ux-reviewer's U8, low, older than that slice; ui-patterns T7).

- [ ] **Do:** on an Android phone with TalkBack on, open Your data from Walk settings and from Chronicle's Contents, then go back by the page's arrow, by the system Back and by the gesture. **Expect:** the arrow is heard "Navigate, back" or "Chronicle, back" and pops the page; the system Back and the gesture pop it too; on iOS the back button reads "Navigate" or "Chronicle" (the arrow alone at large text) and VoiceOver says "Navigate, back button". Never run on a phone. (back-up-everything audit 18)
- [ ] **Do:** on an iPhone, in Chronicle open Contents and tap "Your data"; then tap it twice fast; then from Walk settings tap the row twice fast. **Expect:** the sheet closes and the page is pushed once, never under the closing sheet and never twice (`router.navigate`; iOS cannot present over a closing Modal). Never run on a phone. (back-up-everything audit 11)
